subject: CSV export button unresponsive
description: User clicks export to csv on reports page, nothing happens, no error shown
resolution: Known bug in report cache. Fix: clear browser cache, or ask user to use the 'Export as XLSX' alternative button while we ship the patch in v2.4.1.

subject: Cannot reset password
description: Password reset email never arrives, checked spam folder
resolution: Email delivery delay on our provider's side. Ask user to wait 15 min, or manually trigger reset via admin panel if urgent.

subject: Download report fails silently
description: Trying to download the monthly report as csv, button does nothing at all
resolution: Same root cause as report cache bug. Fix: clear browser cache, or use 'Export as XLSX' alternative while patch v2.4.1 ships.

subject: Invoice PDF shows wrong total
description: Downloaded invoice for last month shows a total that doesn't match the dashboard summary
resolution: Currency rounding bug in invoice generator for accounts with mid-cycle plan changes. Escalated to billing team, fix in v2.5.0. For now, manually recalculate and note discrepancy in the ticket.

subject: Rate limiter drops requests under 50 req/s
description: Load test shows ~12% of requests returning 429 even well under our documented rate limit
resolution: Token bucket refill was using wall-clock time instead of monotonic clock, causing drift under load. Fixed in PR #4821, switched to monotonic timer.

subject: Mobile app crashes on login
description: iOS app crashes immediately after entering credentials and tapping login, happens every time on iPhone 14
resolution: Null pointer in the biometric-prompt code path on iOS 18.1 specifically. Hotfix shipped in app v3.2.1 - ask user to update from App Store.

subject: Notification settings keep resetting
description: Every time I log in on a new device, my email notification preferences go back to default (all on)
resolution: Notification prefs are stored per-device instead of per-account. This is a known limitation, not a bug - documented workaround: set prefs once per device you use.

subject: Webhook retries causing duplicate database rows
description: Seeing duplicate order records when the payment provider's webhook times out and retries
resolution: Missing idempotency key check on the webhook handler. Fixed by hashing the webhook payload and using it as a dedup key with a 24h TTL cache.

subject: Export contacts list to CSV unresponsive
description: On the contacts page, clicking the CSV export icon does nothing, no download starts and no error appears
resolution: Unrelated to the reports-page export bug. This is a separate, older known issue in the contacts module - permissions check silently fails for accounts without the 'data-export' role. Fix: grant the role in admin settings.

subject: Account locked after 5 failed login attempts
description: User tried the wrong password a few times and now sees 'account locked, try again in 24 hours' - they know their correct password now
resolution: This is expected brute-force protection behavior, not a bug. Support can manually unlock via admin panel if the user is verified; do not disable the lockout policy.

subject: CSV export function isn't responding when clicked
description: Clicked the export to csv button on the reports section, page just sits there, nothing downloads
resolution: Known bug in report cache. Fix: clear browser cache, or ask user to use the 'Export as XLSX' alternative button while we ship the patch in v2.4.1.

subject: Nothing is working
description: The whole thing is broken, please help, I don't know what's going on
resolution: No specific technical detail provided. Standard triage response: asked user for screenshots, browser/OS, and specific page where the issue occurs. Escalate to human agent - insufficient info for any automated match.

subject: API calls keep failing randomly during high traffic
description: Our integration gets error 429 Too Many Requests even though we're staying under the documented rate limit, especially during our peak hours
resolution: Confirmed backend bug: rate limiter's token bucket was drifting under load due to wall-clock timing. Fixed in the same release as ENG-193 (PR #4821) - ask customer to confirm resolved after next deploy.

subject: Customers charged twice for the same order
description: Multiple customers reporting duplicate charges on their card for a single purchase, seems to happen more during checkout page slowness
resolution: Root cause: payment webhook retries were creating duplicate order records due to missing idempotency check (same underlying bug as ENG-201). Refund duplicate charges manually until the idempotency-key fix is deployed.
